readiness_rationale: 100% SHA-256 checksum verified official Binance Data Vision archives. Zero missing settlement records across 14 months (1,275/1,275). Point-in-time boundary observable with zero lookahead. Exact 8h interval verified within 15ms clock jitter. Basis alignment verified across thousands of candles.

descriptive_statistics.scientific_disclaimer: SCIENTIFIC NOTICE: Descriptive statistics reflect realized historical settlement events only. Historical average funding rates DO NOT constitute a guaranteed carry yield, risk-free interest, or executable trading alpha. Realized funding is subject to severe regime shifts, market reversals, and basis divergence.

accounting_specification.hedging_architecture: Simultaneous Spot Long and USDT-Margined Perpetual Short with dynamic margin buffer.
accounting_specification.liquidation_buffer_rule: De-risk or rebalance collateral when perp margin ratio breaches 30% of maintenance threshold.
accounting_specification.funding_cash_flow_formula: CashFlow_Funding_t = -1.0 * Position_Perp_Notional_t * Funding_Rate_t (Short receives funding when rate > 0)
accounting_specification.spot_fee_schedule: Tier B Spot Taker (0.0008) on entry/exit; 0.0 on hold.
accounting_specification.perpetual_fee_schedule: Binance USD-M Futures Taker (0.0005) or Maker (0.0002) on position adjustment.
accounting_specification.slippage_and_spread_model: Mandatory 1 to 2 bps bid-ask half-spread applied to both Spot and Perpetual legs.
rebalancing_trigger_conditions: Hedge ratio drift |h - 1.0| > 0.02 due to price movement.
Perp margin health buffer requires capital re-allocation from Spot.
Funding rate turns persistently negative (mean 3-day rate < -2 bps per 8h).
accounting_specification.negative_funding_regime_policy: Mandatory position unwinding when cumulative trailing 72h funding payments turn negative.
operational_and_counterparty_risks: Exchange insolvency or withdrawal freeze (Binance counterparty risk).
Flash crash on Spot while Perpetual decouples upward (basis blowout leading to liquidation).
Execution lag between Spot entry and Perpetual short execution (slippage exposure).
Unbalanced collateral: Spot appreciation does not automatically credit perpetual margin balance.
